tasks.prompt: Explain the authentication flow in this Task Manager API. How does a user register, login, and get access to protected routes? There is a performance bug in the task service: when finding overdue tasks, it fetches ALL overdue tasks from the database and then filters by user ID in memory. This is an N+1 problem. Find this bug in the code, explain why it's a problem, and fix it so the filtering happens at the database query level. Use the tools available to you to explore the codebase. Cite specific files.

Don't change the service layer behavior, only add the middleware guards. Use the tools available to you to explore the codebase. Cite specific files.
